picks.title: Advertisers Pull Meta Ads That Had Unwanted AI Glow-ups
picks.rationale: Meta's new terms, effective Oct 30, make advertisers solely responsible for whatever Meta's Advantage+ AI adds to their ads, and agencies are already pulling live ads over AI edits they never opted into. Anyone running Meta campaigns needs to audit their AI creative toggles this week.
picks.excerpt: Under Meta's new terms coming into play Oct 30, advertisers are "solely responsible" for whatever its AI creates

picks.title: OpenAI Details How ChatGPT's LLM Ad Stack Selects And Serves Ads
picks.rationale: OpenAI has published how its ChatGPT ad stack works: a custom LLM orchestrator reads multi-turn intent, runs the auction and serves sponsored placements. It is the first official look at how ads get picked inside the assistant, which matters for anyone buying that inventory.
picks.excerpt: OpenAI details how the ChatGPT ad stack uses a custom LLM orchestrator to interpret multi-turn intent, run auctions, and serve sponsored placements.

picks.title: Why CNN International is building for agentic ad market that barely exists yet
picks.rationale: CNN International is setting up its inventory to be sold through AI buying agents before that market exists at scale. It shows how a major publisher is getting ready for agent-to-agent media buying on the sell side.
picks.excerpt: Plenty about CNN is up in the air post the Skydance deal. CNN International's plan to sell ads through AI agents isn't among them.

picks.title: AI boosts discovery but reviews still seal the deal, new research shows
picks.rationale: New holiday consumer surveys show shoppers use AI assistants to find gifts but still check reviews, compare prices and read retailer policies before they buy. Retailers putting money into AI shopping surfaces still need to fund reviews and price competitiveness to close the sale.
picks.excerpt: Consumer surveys show AI helps shoppers find gifts, but most check reviews, compare prices and review retailers' policies before buying.

picks.title: 코바코 'AI광고 플랫폼', 불법도박 '슬롯게임'도 뚝딱…필터링 구멍
picks.rationale: At the National Assembly audit, a lawmaker used KOBACO's state-run generative-AI ad tool, AiSAC, to produce storyboards for illegal gambling ads. The demonstration exposed missing safety filters in an AI ad-creation platform offered to advertisers.
picks.excerpt: 이정헌 더불어민주당 의원이 한국방송광고진흥공사(KOBACO)의 생성형 AI 광고 제작 플랫폼이 불법·유해 광고를 제대로 걸러내지 못하고 있다는 점을 지적했다. 이 의원은 22일 국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회 국정감사에서 KOBACO의 AI 광고 창작지원 플랫폼 '아이작(AiSAC)'에 '돈 버는 슬롯게임', '슬롯머신' 등의 키워드를 입력해 불법 도박게임을 홍보하는 광고 스토리보드를 실제로 만들어 보였다.
